summary.en: Past simple, irregular verbs, was/were, past continuous and the present perfect.
summary.bs: Past simple, nepravilni glagoli, was/were, past continuous i present perfect.

concepts.youtubeQuery: past simple tense english regular verbs ed

bs.one: Past simple koristiš za završenu radnju u prošlosti, u poznato vrijeme: I worked yesterday.
bs.explain: Pravilni glagoli dobijaju -ed: work → worked, play → played, live → lived, stop → stopped, study → studied. Isti oblik za sve osobe. Pitanje: 'Did you work?' Negacija: 'I didn't work.' Poslije 'did' glagol je opet osnovni. Znakovi: yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago.
bs.example: 'Yesterday I cleaned the flat and watched a film.' 'Did you call her?' 'No, I didn't call her.'
bs.why: Ovim vremenom pričaš priče, iskustva i šta si radio vikendom.
bs.mixup: 'Did you went?' je pogrešno. Prošlost se pokazuje samo jednom: 'Did you go?'

concepts.youtubeQuery: most common irregular verbs english list pronunciation

bs.one: Nepravilni glagoli (irregular verbs) ne dobijaju -ed u prošlosti, nego mijenjaju oblik: go → went, see → saw.
bs.explain: Uče se napamet u tri oblika: osnovni, past simple, particip (past participle). Na primjer: go – went – gone, eat – ate – eaten, have – had – had, make – made – made, take – took – taken, buy – bought – bought. Treći oblik ti treba za present perfect i pasiv.
bs.example: 'Last summer we went to the sea. We ate fish and took lots of photos.'
bs.why: Najčešći engleski glagoli su upravo nepravilni. Bez njih ne možeš ispričati ni običan dan.
bs.mixup: Ne dodaji -ed nepravilnim glagolima: 'goed' i 'buyed' ne postoje. Uči po 10 glagola sedmično (tjedno) u sva tri oblika.

concepts.youtubeQuery: was and were past of to be english

bs.one: Prošlost od 'to be' ima dva oblika: was (I, he, she, it) i were (you, we, they).
bs.explain: Kao i u sadašnjosti, nema 'did': pitanje praviš zamjenom reda ('Were you at home?'), negaciju s 'not' (I wasn't, they weren't). Uz 'there': 'There was a problem', 'There were many people'.
bs.example: 'I was tired yesterday. We were at a wedding. Was the food good?'
bs.why: Koristiš ga za opisivanje prošlih stanja, mjesta i osjećaja.
bs.mixup: 'You was' je pogrešno, čak i kad misliš na jednu osobu: 'you' uvijek ide s 'were'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: past continuous tense english was were ing

bs.one: Past continuous opisuje radnju koja je trajala u nekom trenutku u prošlosti: I was sleeping at 11.
bs.explain: Oblik: was/were + glagol s -ing. Često ide s past simple: duža radnja (continuous) je prekinuta kraćom (simple). Veznici: when (kad), while (dok).
bs.example: 'I was cooking when the phone rang.' 'While we were walking, it started to rain.'
bs.why: Pomaže ti da u priči postaviš scenu: šta se dešavalo kad se nešto desilo.
bs.mixup: Kraća radnja koja prekida ide u past simple: 'when the phone rang', ne 'when the phone was ringing'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: present perfect tense english explained have has

bs.one: Present perfect povezuje prošlost sa sadašnjošću: I have finished (završio sam i to je važno sada).
bs.explain: Oblik: have/has + treći oblik glagola (worked, gone, seen). Koristiš ga za: iskustvo bez tačnog vremena (I have been to London), nešto što je upravo završeno (I've just eaten), i stanje koje traje do sada (I have lived here for 5 years). Riječi: ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since.
bs.example: 'Have you ever eaten sushi?' 'I've lost my keys' (i još ih nemam). 'She has worked here since 2019.'
bs.why: Bosanski ovo kaže prošlim vremenom, pa je ovo jedno od najtežih pravila za naše govornike.
bs.mixup: 'For' ide uz trajanje (for 3 years), 'since' uz početnu tačku (since 2020). 'I live here since 2020' je pogrešno; treba 'I have lived here since 2020'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: present perfect vs past simple difference

bs.one: Ako kažeš KADA se desilo (yesterday, in 2015, last week), koristi past simple. Ako vrijeme nije važno ili traje do sada, koristi present perfect.
bs.explain: Past simple = završeno, odvojeno od sada, poznato vrijeme. Present perfect = 'do sada', 'u životu', rezultat koji se vidi sada. Uz 'ago', 'yesterday' i 'when' nikad ne ide present perfect.
bs.example: 'I have visited Rome.' (nekad u životu) → 'I visited Rome in 2019.' (poznato vrijeme)
bs.why: Ovo je granica koju izvorni govornici odmah čuju.
bs.mixup: 'I have seen him yesterday' je pogrešno. 'Yesterday' traži past simple: 'I saw him yesterday'.

explain.bs: Nepravilan glagol: buy – bought – bought. (Brought je od 'bring'.)
Radnja je trajala i bila je prekinuta: past continuous.

options.bs: I have met her last year.
I have meet her last year.

explain.bs: 'Last year' je tačno vrijeme: past simple.
